name: upstream/safelist-blocklist
description: `safelist: [<string>, …]` lifts additional class names into the candidate set regardless of scanner output. `blocklist: [<string>, …]` excludes class names from output even if the scanner saw them. Pattern-form safelist (`{ pattern: /…/ }`) is a Phase carry-over — would need to enumerate every possible candidate. Mirrors upstream's `safelist.test.js` and `blocklist.test.js`.
